title: IPv6 tailnet: owner_login always empty at startup
description: main.rs:96 uses format!("{ip_str}:443").parse::<SocketAddr>() to build the WhoIs address for the owner. For an IPv6 tailnet IP like fd7a::1, this produces fd7a::1:443 which is not valid SocketAddr syntax (IPv6 requires brackets: [fd7a::1]:443). The parse fails, the warn fires, and owner_login is permanently empty. The Session object omits ownerLogin for every IPv6-only deployment.
